text: do some research for all those items in the real world, and their average size, compare to what the game items size is
resolution: Researched real-world average sizes for all 54 prop kinds (web research: MUTCD specs for stop sign/traffic signal mounting, street light pole standards, utility pole 35ft standard, 4-yd dumpster, fire hydrant 24-42in; regulation soccer/basketball sizes; standard furniture dims) and compared to the game's propKinds.ts values via tools/prop-scale. Wrote docs/game/_reports/PROP-REALWORLD-AUDIT.md with full per-prop tables. Headline: ~80% of the catalog is real-world accurate (several exact to the cm); trees are ~HALF real size (the one family contradicting R4 scale-verticals-UP); street light 35% short; fire hydrant 30% tall; beach ball is giant-novelty size. Systematic: real-scale props read ~13% small against the stylized-tall 2.01m player (real adult ~1.75m). No code changed — analysis only; decisions on trees/streetlight/hydrant left to the user.
